The '''TIE torpedo''' was a sleek, one-man attack [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] under development by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Juggerhead]] on [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. It was researched in secret, under the cover of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] construction. The former Imperial research facility was scrapped in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] when Bestine had joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />
